page.overview:
What is Plant?

Plants can be found in water or on land, and include structures and blocks such as flowers, trees and crops. Most are renewable, generally by growing.

The following list plants and plant-like things in the game.

The following behave similarly to plants in Minecraft, but are based on, or styled after real-world organisms that are not [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plant plants] by the biological definition.

de:Gewächs es:Plantas fr:Plantes hu:Növények ja:植物 ko:식물 nl:Planten pl:Rośliny ru:Растения th:พืช (แก้ความกำกวม) zh:植物
